entities.summary: Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani is a Syrian diplomat and politician who has been serving as the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates since 2024. He is one of Ahmed al-Sharaa's closest allies and one of the most prominent figures in the country's post-Assad government.
